assay: bulk mRNA-seq (TruSeq stranded polyA, NextSeq 500 75bp SE) of quadriceps
primary_estimand: Effect of 4 weeks voluntary wheel running (Ex, harvested 4-6 h after last bout) vs sedentary wild-type controls (Con) on quadriceps gene expression in male C57BL/6J mice
sample_inclusion: n = 5 quadriceps per group (Fig 8A legend); all 15 deposited RNA-seq samples
planned_contrasts: EX vs SED in quadriceps (S2.6.p1, Fig 8A left; paper: 779 up, 783 down = 1562 DEGs)
MTG vs SED in quadriceps (S2.6.p1, Fig 8A right; paper: 2843 up, 2739 down = 5582 DEGs) - non-exercise comparison, secondary
repeated_measure_unit: none; one quadriceps per independent mouse
paper_method: STAR (mm10) + DESeq2 via Illumina BaseSpace DESeq2 v1.1.0 app, direct pairwise comparisons Con vs Ex and Con vs mTg (S4.7.p1)
normalization: DESeq2 internal size factors on counts; FPKM used only for heatmaps/clustering (S4.7.p1)

paper_results.named_genes: Acadl up and Myh4 down with exercise (S2.7.p1, Fig 9C)
